name: hyphon-daw
description: Sequencer-driven Web Audio workstation inspired by the Korg Electribe EA-1 ER-1.

scripts.build:wasm: pnpm run build:wasm:oscillators && pnpm run build:wasm:freezer && pnpm run build:wasm:audioexport && pnpm run build:wasm:xmexport && pnpm run build:wasm:fft && pnpm run build:wasm:rust && pnpm run build:wasm:jc303
scripts.build:wasm:oscillators: asc assembly/oscillators.ts -o src/wasm/oscillators.wasm --optimize --converge --optimizeLevel 3 --enable simd --enable bulk-memory --enable threads --initialMemory 384 --exportRuntime --bindings esm
scripts.build:wasm:freezer: asc assembly/trackFreezer.ts -o src/wasm/trackFreezer.wasm --optimize --converge --optimizeLevel 3 --enable simd --enable bulk-memory --initialMemory 128 --exportRuntime --bindings esm
scripts.build:wasm:fft: asc assembly/fft.ts -o src/wasm/fft.wasm --optimize --converge --optimizeLevel 3 --enable simd --enable bulk-memory --initialMemory 256 --exportRuntime --bindings esm
scripts.build:wasm:audioexport: asc assembly/audioExport.ts -o src/wasm/audioExport.wasm --optimize --converge --optimizeLevel 3 --enable simd --enable bulk-memory --initialMemory 128 --exportRuntime --bindings esm
scripts.build:wasm:xmexport: asc assembly/xmExport.ts -o src/wasm/xmExport.wasm --optimize --converge --optimizeLevel 3 --enable simd --enable bulk-memory --initialMemory 128 --exportRuntime --bindings esm
scripts.build:release: pnpm run build:native && node tools/check_wasm_export_map.mjs --glue public/hyphon_native.js && pnpm run build:web && node scripts/write-native-manifest.mjs --out dist/native-artifacts.json && node scripts/check-release-dist.mjs
scripts.build:release:changed: pnpm run build:native:changed && node tools/check_wasm_export_map.mjs --glue public/hyphon_native.js && pnpm run build:web && node scripts/write-native-manifest.mjs --out dist/native-artifacts.json && node scripts/check-release-dist.mjs
scripts.test:perf: vitest run --config vitest.perf.config.ts --pool forks && node scripts/collect-vitest-perf.mjs perf-summary.json
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:perf
